name: Zuar
overview: Zuar is identified in Scripture as the father of Nethaneel, a prominent leader of the tribe of Issachar. The passages in Numbers highlight Nethaneel's role as captain and prince of Issachar, emphasizing his leadership in the camp and his responsibility in offering sacrifices on behalf of his tribe. Through these references, Zuar is connected to a lineage of faithful service and leadership within Israel during their wilderness journey.
